decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.7789. Series context: trend strength 0.9993 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.033); 10 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.835.
